- [ASSISTANT_SAID] These nuts contain high levels of unsaturated fats, fiber, and antioxidants that can lower cholesterol levels and reduce the risk of heart disease.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended to include a variety of nuts in the diet for balanced nutrient intake.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Soaking nuts can increase digestibility and enhance bioavailability of nutrients.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Roasting nuts can improve flavor and texture but may reduce nutrient content in some cases.
